pr.title: Point spec, fix-pr, and finish at the testing guide
pr.head: d8179edc934586111e6cac19409043fdf17c8434

summary: Projector's skills are Markdown instructions that an agent follows: spec writes a project's plan, implement builds it, review-pr reviews a pull request, fix-pr fixes review findings, and finish checks that a project is done. The testing guide in skills/testing.md is a shared rule document for tests. It asks every test to name the bug it catches, and it rejects a test that only restates a value the code holds.

Before this change, only implement and the review method cited the guide at the step where they handle a test. This change adds a citation at the matching step in three more skills, and updates docs/plugins.md to say which skills follow the guide and where:

• spec names the bug each acceptance test catches, so a plan never asks for a test that restates the code.
  • fix-pr writes its failing test and its regression test by the guide.
  • finish does not count a test that catches nothing as evidence that a project is done.
The review found one open problem: three edited lines do not match the line wrapping around them, which the repository's CLAUDE.md asks of every Markdown edit. Each file below flags its line.

cards.title: Testing guide sections the change cites
cards.html:
• § 1. Write a test only when you can name the bug it catches.
  • § 2. A test that asserts a value is what the code sets it to catches nothing.
  • § 3. Test what a value must agree with, not the value.
  • § 4. Other tests that catch nothing: tests of a mock, tests that cannot fail, change detectors, and more.

groups.title: Three skills cite the guide where they handle a test
groups.kicker: spec, fix-pr, and finish each gain one or two sentences at the step that plans, writes, or accepts a test.
